definitions.explanation: The cost of transportation for a passenger.

examples.japanese: {運賃|うんちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
{運賃|うんちん}⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運賃|うんちん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いくら→いくら：00943_ikura⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the shipping charge for the package?

examples.japanese: {運賃|うんちん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The freight charge varies by weight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運賃|うんちん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Shipping charges to overseas are expensive.

notes:
Composed of {運|うん} (transport) + {賃|ちん} (fee/charge). Covers both passenger fares and freight charges.

PASSENGER FARE TERMS:
- {運賃|うんちん}⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧: fare chart
- ⟦{片道|かたみち}→片道：00199_katamichi⟧{運賃|うんちん}: one-way fare
- ⟦{往復|おうふく}→往復：04111_oufuku⟧{運賃|うんちん}: round-trip fare
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧{運賃|うんちん}: child fare
- {運賃|うんちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the fare

FREIGHT:
Also used for shipping costs of goods. For online shopping, ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧ (shipping fee) is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: charge, fee (broader term)
- {運賃|うんちん}: specifically transportation fare
- ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧: shipping fee (e-commerce)
- ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧: transportation expenses (reimbursement context)
